strings.subtitle: — Chiphuluski cha Fayilo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Koka kulije. Gwiritsani ntchito batani pasi.
strings.shred_button: P H U L U S K A
strings.ssd_warning: Chenjezo! Pa SSD, njira iyi yikukhumba kuti yiphuluske chifukwa cha TRIM. Pulogalamu iyi ni ya HDD pera.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Ichi shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut pera ichiwonongeka.

Faili iyo yikulongola yikhakhalapo.

Lutilizga?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Ichi network drive (\\server\share).
Kulemba pa sektore chikuchita kuti chingawonongeka yayi — server yingaŵa na snapshot, deduplication panji CoW.

Lutilizga?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Ichi removable drive (USB / HDD wakunja).
Controller yingasunga maboko ghakale mu reserve.

Lutilizga?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS njira zinyake za data (ADS) zikugwira ntchito yayi.
• USN jarida likusezgeka yayi.
• Makopi ghachisyu na sinkronizasi ya wingu
  (OneDrive na vinyake) vikukhuzgika yayi.
strings.status_full: Vili mukati vyose vyasinthika na ziro. Vingazgoka yayi — vinthu vingawona ziro pera.
strings.status_fast: Mutu, mchira na mizere ya 4 MB yasinthika. Vyakukwana vikukhuzgika yayi, kweni chifukwa cha malo, fayilo yingazgoka yayi yose. Pa makalata ghachisisi gwiritsani ntchito ndondomeko YOSE.
strings.status_empty: Fayilo yikaŵa palije, kusintha kukukhumbika yayi. Yiphuluskika.
strings.error_permission: Tikuleka kufikira faili. Yingaŵa yikutsegulika mu pulogilamu yinyake. Jala ni kuyesa ndende.
strings.error_not_found: Faili yikusangika yayi. Yingaŵa yikuchitika kale.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ichi symbolic link. Malink ghakuleka kuwonongeka — faili yikulongola yikhakhalapo.
strings.error_reparse: Ichi placeholder faili (OneDrive panji yinyake). Data yake yikusungika mu cloud, yayi pa disk — palije chinthu chakuwonongeka pano.
strings.error_not_file: Ichi faili yayi (folda panji chinthu chinyake). Dontha faili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faili iyi yili na hard link zinyake ({n} wose). Hard link zilije mulara — mazina wose ghakuyana. Usange mukuwononga mu nthowa iyi, data yikulembeka ni kukatika ku 32 bytes, kweni vyakusara vikukhala kufikikapo mu malink yinyake. Fumyani malink wose pambere.
strings.error_compressed:
Faili yikusindikizga, yikusungika panji yikusintha. Kulemba na ziro kukuchita kuti data yakale yingawonongeka yayi chifukwa NTFS yikusunga munjira yinyake.

Fumyani chikhalidwe: dinda kumanja → Vinyake → Vyakukulira → fumyani 'Sindikiza' na/panji 'Sunga'. Ndende tulutsani SHREDDER.
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Kukoma panyuma ya faili ya sono...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Mafaili {count} ghachiwonongeka.
Ukuru wose: {size}.

Wona ndondomeko pambere undapite.
Ichi chinthu chingachitika yayi.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Fumyani mafaili wose {count} mu mzere?

Mafaili ghakwiza GHACHIKHUMBANA yayi — ndondomeko pera.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faili "{name}" ghili na hard link zinyake ({nlink} wose).

Data yichiwonongeka pa mazina wose.
Kweni vyakusara (32 bytes) vichikhala pasi pa mazina yinyake mu folda.

Mungafumya vyakusara ivi na mawoko.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Gwilitsani ku hard link zose mu mzere
